title: Assurance policy
intro: Which actions need a second person (four-eyes) and which need a fresh confirmation that it is the signed-in person (step-up). Locked rules are the baseline and cannot be lowered. A stricter rule applies at once; a looser one waits for a second administrator (at most 7 days).
docs: What is enforced and what proves it: docs/ASSURANCE.md
maxAgeLabel: Maximum age of the confirmation in minutes: {{point}}

mfa.title: What counts as multi-factor
mfa.hint: A single sign-on step-up shows multi-factor authentication when the ID token’s amr contains one of these values, or its acr is one of the acr values (which Steward then asks the provider for). A password step-up never counts where MFA is required.

loosens_one: {{count}} change loosens the policy: it waits for a second administrator.
loosens_other: {{count}} changes loosen the policy: they wait for a second administrator.
saved: Saved: the stricter rules apply now.
savedPending: Saved: the looser rules wait for a second administrator.
unchanged: Nothing changed – the baseline cannot be lowered.

pending.title: A looser policy waits for a second administrator
pending.by: Asked for by {{user}} on {{date}} – expires on {{expires}}.
pending.approved: Approved: the looser rules apply now.
pending.rejected: Rejected: the rules stay as they are.

overrides.title: Overrides of single items
overrides.hint: These items add to the policy where they are set. The rule that applies to each is the strictest of the baseline, the policy and the item.
overrides.empty: No item adds to the policy.

history.title: History
history.empty: The policy has not changed yet: the defaults apply.

report.title: Assurance report
report.hint: The policy in force in a period and its changes, per control point how each event was confirmed, and the exceptions (emergency sign-ins, missing MFA, loosening). PDF/A, also part of evidence packs.

create.label: Create an API token
create.description: A token outlives the session and acts as the person.

create.label: Create an account with roles
create.description: A new account with roles gives lasting access.

change.label: Change an account's roles or sign-in
change.description: Roles, the sign-in provider an account is bound to, activating or deactivating an administrator.

resetPassword.label: Reset a password
resetPassword.description: A temporary password lets the administrator sign in as the person.

members.label: Add team members or roles in a team
members.description: Teams are subjects of access lists: a new member gets their rights.

grant.label: Give rights in an access list
grant.description: Access lists of platforms, processes and monitors, owning teams, copies with their access settings.

providers.label: Add, change or delete a sign-in provider
providers.description: Single sign-on providers decide who signs in as whom.

settings.label: Change sign-in, outbound or four-eyes settings
settings.description: Password sign-in, the outbound policy and allow-list, turning four-eyes dismissals off.

passphrase.label: Change the master passphrase
passphrase.description: The passphrase protects every credential and the audit key.

policy.label: Change the assurance policy
policy.description: This policy itself: every change needs a step-up; loosening it a second administrator.

decide.label: Document or dismiss access check findings
decide.description: Decisions on undocumented access changes. Four-eyes: dismissals are confirmed by a second person (also the setting under Settings → Catalogue).

decide.label: Submit and approve person access reviews
decide.description: Four-eyes: a second person approves the review (each review has its own switch).

anchoring.label: Change audit anchoring and archiving
anchoring.description: Where the signed checkpoints go, and archiving of old entries.

export.label: Export the audit log
export.description: The audit log, its archives and the assurance report leave Steward in bulk.

export.label: Export an evidence pack
export.description: Evidence of a period leaves Steward in bulk.

export.label: Export the credential register
export.description: The register (no secrets) leaves Steward as CSV.

approve.label: Approve or reject a record
approve.description: The owner, author, submitter and content authors never decide their own record. A step-up makes the decision an electronic-signature-like confirmation.

reviewOwner.label: Make oneself the review owner of a document
reviewOwner.description: An approver who wrote a document cannot make themselves its review owner.

close.label: Close a firewall change
close.description: Closing a record of the type FWC (firewall change). Without that type, nothing reaches this point.

decide.label: Decide an approval in a run
decide.description: Four-eyes: someone other than the person who started the run decides (each step has its own switch).

verify.label: Verify a manual step
verify.description: Whoever completed a manual step or added its evidence never verifies it.

skip.label: Decide an exception of a service duty
skip.description: Another person than the one who asked decides.

write.label: Approve a changing call of an AI assistant
write.description: Per platform: confirmed by the token owner or approved by a second person. Required: every platform needs a second person.

allowWrites.label: Let AI assistants request changing calls
allowWrites.description: Turning on changing calls through MCP on a platform, or confirm instead of four-eyes.

allowClient.label: Allow an AI assistant (MCP client)
allowClient.description: The client then acts as the person through MCP.

ciaScale.label: Change the CIA scale
ciaScale.description: It maps or flags the protection needs of every application at once.

delivery.label: Change where notifications go
delivery.description: SMTP server, Teams and webhook URLs, the base URL of links, allowed e-mail domains, the emergency alert.

settings.label: Change the backups
settings.description: Where encrypted backups go and their passphrase.

export.label: Export this instance
export.description: Every credential leaves in the package.

budget.label: Raise an AI token budget
budget.description: More tokens a day or a month for the installation, an LLM gateway or a process – or no limit any more. Lowering a budget needs no confirmation.

budget.label: Raise a cost budget
budget.description: A higher monthly cost budget of a service, application or team, another currency, or no budget any more. Lowering a budget needs no confirmation.

teamsLabel: May be decided in Microsoft Teams
teamsAria: {{point}}: may be decided in Microsoft Teams
